sentences.text: Mira, an 8-year-old spayed Domestic Shorthair, refused every z/d feeding from Jun 5 to 19, 30 in a row and 34 of 38 rated feedings refused, and the trial was stopped on day 19 of 42.
Intake not directly observed: a free-fed Purina ONE bowl was down, and she lives with 1 other cat.
Weight is −6.8% in 18 days, 4.4 to 4.1 kg on 2 home-scale readings.
In cats, 48 to 72 hours of markedly reduced intake is a hepatic-lipidosis risk window, and nothing is recorded after Jun 19, 13 days before this report.
Vomiting has 5 entries on 5 of 19 logged days, against an owner-entered history of chronic vomiting since Apr 10.
